metadata.title_tag: WebCatalog: Organize Apps Without Losing Account Context
metadata.meta_description: Evaluate WebCatalog for multiple apps and accounts: compare workspace needs, plan limits and one real client workflow before moving everything.

hero.headline: Keep each client workspace easier to read
hero.subheadline: WebCatalog may suit people who manage several web apps and accounts. Test it with one client workflow before moving your wider setup. The decision is whether its desktop apps, profiles and spaces make your work easier to follow.
hero.risk_reversal: Check current terms and suitability before committing.
hero.answer_snippet: WebCatalog may suit people who manage several web apps and accounts. Test it with one client workflow before moving your wider setup. The decision is whether its desktop apps, profiles and spaces make your work easier to follow.

problem_solution.problem: Which account and project needs your attention now?
problem_solution.agitation: A new tool helps only when the arrangement still makes sense after an interruption.
problem_solution.solution: Pick one project and a few daily tasks. Compare those tasks in your current browser setup and in WebCatalog.

benefits.benefit_description: Write down the apps, accounts and project groups you use before choosing a plan.
Decide whether you need a personal arrangement or a shared setup for colleagues.
benefits.feature_supporting_it: Shared spaces appear in the Business plan

benefits.benefit_description: Try one representative workflow and note login, notification, or navigation friction.
benefits.feature_supporting_it: Basic has 2 desktop apps, 2 profiles and 1 space

proof_blocks.summary: WebCatalog's official comparison lists desktop apps, profiles and spaces for macOS, Windows and Linux. Basic includes 2 apps, 2 profiles and 1 space; Pro removes these limits; Business adds shared spaces and team management.

how_it_works.title: Pick a representative project
how_it_works.description: Choose a project with two accounts you often mix up. Write down the tasks you need to finish.

how_it_works.title: Set up a small arrangement
how_it_works.description: Name each account and project clearly. Confirm the active context before you send or edit anything.

how_it_works.title: Compare a normal session
how_it_works.description: Record setup effort and resource use across interruptions. Keep the current setup if the new one adds friction.

limitations.limitation: Installation still needs an IT review
limitations.mitigation: Ask IT to assess access, installation and data-handling requirements before introducing another desktop application.

limitations.limitation: A browser may already be sufficient
limitations.who_it_affects: People using few apps or one account
limitations.mitigation: Compare with your current browser profiles before paying for a separate workspace tool.

objection_handling.objection: What would make this a poor fit?
objection_handling.response: Compare it with your current browser profiles before paying for another workspace tool.

cta_blocks.label: Review WebCatalog
cta_blocks.supporting_text: Use one of your own workflows to decide.

faq.question: Will it use less memory than my browser?
faq.answer: We have not measured that. Compare the same apps and workload on your device, and do not assume an app container is lighter.

faq.question: Should I choose a shared setup?
faq.answer: Agree who will maintain it and which client accounts may be included. Then check whether the current plan supports your collaboration needs.

faq.question: What is the review based on?
faq.answer: This review uses official documentation checked on 13 October 2026. The workflow checks are editorial guidance, not test results.
